Lemma
[The Euclidean Distance, real-valued form]

↗ prop:euclidean-riemannian-distance

With the notation of Proposition 2, $d_{\bar g}(x,y)$ is finite and equals $|x-y|$ as a real number.
Proof

↗ prop:euclidean-riemannian-distance \sketch Proposition 2 identifies the distance with the finite real number $|x-y|$.

□

A connected Riemannian manifold is metrically complete if every Cauchy sequence converges. A subset $A\subseteq M$ is bounded if $d_g(p,q)\le C$ for all $p,q\in A$ and some $C$; its diameter is \[ \operatorname {diam}(A)=\sup \{ d_g(p,q):p,q\in A\} . \] Every compact connected Riemannian manifold with or without boundary has finite diameter.
